question: Will China authorize NVIDIA to sell H200 chips in mainland China by 2027-01-31, as verified by an official Chinese government or regulatory announcement or licensing decision, or by NVIDIA disclosing that H200 sales or shipments to China have resumed?
rungs: rung 1 Yes: By 2027-01-31, China has authorized H200 sales in mainland China, or NVIDIA has disclosed that H200 sales or shipments to China have resumed.

rung 2 Ruled out: By 2027-01-31, China has formally denied authorization or officially decided to continue barring H200 imports. This rung holds when that, or any other decision against the event of rung 1 as a whole, or a formal abandonment or withdrawal of it as a whole, was made after 2026-07-02 and stands on 2027-01-31, and only when rung 1 does not.
rung 3 Still open: Neither rung 1 nor rung 2 holds on 2027-01-31.

facts_on_the_due_day.facts: In March 2026 China officially decided to continue barring H200 imports. Nothing has been decided or announced since, and NVIDIA has disclosed no H200 sales or shipments to China.

In November 2026 China authorized H200 sales in mainland China.
